# Texh Co

> Texh Co builds websites, custom software and automation for local businesses in New Jersey and New York. We set up the system behind the business: bookings, follow-ups, Google visibility and weekly reporting, all on the client's own domain and data. Bilingual (English and Spanish).

## Services

- [Web development](https://texhco.com/services/web-development): mobile-first sites with bookings and quote requests built in.
- [Custom software](https://texhco.com/services/custom-software): owner dashboards, client portals, scheduling and invoicing.
- [Automation](https://texhco.com/services/automation): booking confirmations, reminders, review requests, lead routing and win-back messages.
- [Digital growth](https://texhco.com/services/digital-growth): Google Business Profile, local SEO and a weekly report of calls, bookings and leads.

## Work

- [Selected work](https://texhco.com/#work): real projects, including BackSoon, our own digital loyalty card product for Apple and Google Wallet (https://backsoon.us).
